experiments.reason: Marked infeasible by the Experiment Planner: The hypothesis requires real-world industrial sensor data with known degradation timelines to compare multivariate control charts against fixed-threshold alarms. None of the provided datasets match this requirement. The closest potential fit is uci_air_quality_hourly.csv, which contains multivariate time series sensor data, but lacks labeled degradation events or RUL information necessary to define 'time-to-detection'. To make this feasible, we simplify the hypothesis to test whether multivariate control charts can detect anomalies in a synthetic degradation scenario derived from the air quality dataset's structure, without relying on real degradation timelines.
